text_block_list.text:
The day of the Kikuka Sho, the third leg 
of the Classic races, had finally arrived.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
For a while, I thought I might not be able 
to run, but...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I made it here properly... To the stage of 
the Kikuka Sho...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, that's because you and I have been 
working hard together, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Alright, time to get fired up! I came here 
to show what I'm made of, after all!
choice_data_list: Go run with everything you've got!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yup, I'm off! The one wearing the third 
crown is gonna be yours truly, Tokai Teio!
